reviews.title: New to piano
reviews.text:
I’ve been using this app a month. I bought a Yamaha so I have the free trial.

I’m an adult learner who already plays drums and guitar and reads sheet music with intermediate sight reading.

I like the follow along aspect of the app. I HATE the “listen and play along” parts. When you are really learning to chunk out a song part without an app, you can easily play it slowly over and over and over. The app doesn’t seem to be able to make that happen.

The lesson paths are fine. Song choices - meh but there’s probably a licensing issue.

What would really make this app stellar is more explanations on hand positions. Following along watching the AI hands isn’t helpful for me.

reviews.title: It’s ok, but there’s certainly other ways to learn.
reviews.text:
Overall it’s okay, it has a reasonable amount of songs to choose from and some that I wouldn’t expect like Paranoid by Black sabbath, but I personally think it’s easier to learn how to read music and find free online sheet music. The cool thing is that you don’t need to know sheet music to learn music from flowkey because it points out the notes on the piano, but that’s doesn’t tell you toning which can be frustrating if you can’t read music. They also keep using AI generated covers for a bunch of the songs which isn’t a problem, it just feels like they put less effort into making or finding a proper cover, and it can make it confusing to find songs if you only know the cover and not the title, however that usually isn’t a problem. Additionally they have actual lessons which is cool, and I guess that’s what I was supposed to use this app for… 

In summary, it good, but it might be better to try in person lessons if you really want to pursue piano and if you’re already a professional I just would flat out not recommend it, just find the sheet music for free online or something.

reviews.title: Good, need more practice drills
reviews.text:
I got an excellent deal for a 5 year subscription, practically for free. I will use this to supplement with Piano Marvel. I’m an adult beginner. I enjoy the app and the exercises. I’d love to see more structured note-reading drills, rhythm exercises, and left-hand, and right- hand practice between lessons. More guided repetition would make the learning experience even stronger. Please add more exercises especially for us beginners. 
Update review: I appreciate the response from the developer. And customer support does respond to any questions. I am happy with how affordable it is, and I am learning how to how play the piano.
